facts.fact: BOPA reports Botswana's 57-clause Access to Information Bill of 2024 passed committee stage without amendments and was approved for third reading.

BWA.note: The document only says the Data Protection Bill would continue the Information and Data Protection Commission; a bill names no authority in law and no appointment or ruling is stated.

facts.fact: BOPA reports Botswana's 101-clause Data Protection Bill of 2024 passed committee stage with a few amendments and was approved for third reading, not yet assented.
